WITH sales_by_code AS (
    SELECT product_code,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_rows,
           COUNT(sold_quantity) AS populated_quantities,
           MIN(date) AS first_date,
           MAX(date) AS last_date
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
),
dimension_by_code AS (
    SELECT product_code, COUNT(*) AS dimension_rows
    FROM main.hardware_dim_product
    GROUP BY product_code
)
SELECT SUM(s.sales_rows) AS sales_rows,
       SUM(s.populated_quantities) AS populated_quantities,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.dimension_rows IS NULL THEN s.sales_rows ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_sales_rows,
       SUM(s.sales_rows * d.dimension_rows) AS joined_sales_rows,
       MIN(s.first_date) AS first_sales_date,
       MAX(s.last_date) AS last_sales_date,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT division) FROM main.hardware_dim_product) AS division_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product) FROM main.hardware_dim_product) AS product_names,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) FROM main.hardware_dim_product) AS product_codes
FROM sales_by_code AS s
LEFT JOIN dimension_by_code AS d ON d.product_code = s.product_code;

    SELECT product_code, SUM(sold_quantity) AS units
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
),
positions AS (
    SELECT p.division, p.product_code, p.product, p.variant, s.units,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.division
               ORDER BY s.units DESC, p.product_code
           ) AS position
    FROM code_sales AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
)
SELECT division, position, product_code, product, variant, units
FROM positions
WHERE position <= 4
ORDER BY division, position

WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT product_code, SUM(sold_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01'
      AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT t.total_quantity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.division
               ORDER BY t.total_quantity DESC, t.product_code
           ) AS division_rank
    FROM product_totals AS t
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = t.product_code
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE division_rank <= 3
LIMIT 1
